name: Prompt Engineering
description: Get useful results from AI tools with clear instructions.
about: Learn how to write prompts that give AI tools the context, examples and constraints they need, and how to iterate when the first answer is not right.
learnings: Write clear prompts; give context and examples; iterate on weak answers

chapters.name: Clear instructions
chapters.description: Say what you want, for whom, and in what shape.

activities.name: Anatomy of a good prompt
body: p:A strong prompt names the task, gives the context the tool cannot guess, and describes the format you want back.

code.text: Explain photosynthesis to a 12-year-old in 5 bullet points, using one everyday example.

a: Summarise this article in 3 bullet points for a busy student

activities.name: Iterate on weak answers
body: h2:The first answer is a draft
p:If the answer misses, say what was wrong and what to change instead of starting over.

ul: Too long? Ask for a word limit.
Too vague? Ask for an example.

assignment.title: Better prompts
assignment.description: Pick the stronger prompt each time.

tasks.title: Choosing prompts
tasks.hint: Look for task, context and format.

questions.q: What should a prompt usually include?
a: Task, context and the format you want

questions.q: The answer was too long. What do you do?
a: Ask again with a length limit

assignment.title: Prompt Engineering unit test
assignment.description: Pass with 80% to complete the course.

questions.q: Why give context in a prompt?
a: The tool cannot guess what it isn't told
Refining the prompt based on the last answer
Repeating the same prompt word for word
